quotelist.quote: The 2027 Bataleon Evil Twin is a legendary freestyle icon, built for riders who want precision, pop and total park domination.
Ideal for intermediate to advanced freestyle riders who spend their time in the park but still want all-mountain capability.

citation.reasoning: S2AS is an authorised UK retailer listing the 2027 model. Their product description confirms the board's category, target rider, and flex. Reliable for marketing-level claims.

quotelist.quote: The Evil Twin is the ultimate twin board, renowned for its versatility and performance on the mountain.

citation.reasoning: Official Bataleon manufacturer page for the 25/26 Evil Twin. Primary authority for specifications, descriptions, and pricing. Marketing claims should be treated as promotional.

Hyper Glide S – Bataleon's standard sintered base that's durable and fast.

citation.reasoning: Blauer Board Shop is a well-known US snowboard retailer. Provides consistent technical descriptions matching Bataleon's official specs. Confirms Hyper Glide S base for the standard Evil Twin.

quotelist.quote: For this special 20th Anniversary edition, we dove into the vault to combine elements from our favorite OG Evil Twins.
A premium, 7000-grade sintered base reserved for our high-end models.

citation.reasoning: Official Bataleon page for the 20Y anniversary variant. Confirms Ultra Glide S 7000-grade base is for high-end models, not the standard Evil Twin.

quotelist.quote: All Bataleon twin snowboards come with a 2+1 year warranty & free shipping.

citation.reasoning: Official Bataleon collection page confirming warranty terms for all twin boards.

citation.reasoning: UK specialist snowboard shop run by snowboarders. Provides detailed expert descriptions of board characteristics and pricing. Highly informative independent retailer.
